summary: Review cycle chemistry, sampling and deviation response for thermal power stations. Explore the course outline and practical learning outcomes.
lede: Thermal power station water chemistry covers sampling and interpretation of water and steam conditions across the station cycle. For plant chemists, operations engineers and water-treatment specialists, the practical task is to assess cycle chemistry and prepare responses to deviations. The training develops skills in sampling checks, feedwater and boiler-water trend interpretation, analyzer and laboratory result comparison, and documenting chemistry controls and escalation decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who collect, interpret or act on steam-water cycle chemistry data in thermal power stations.
audience: Power Generation Reliability Engineers using chemistry histories
prerequisites: Working familiarity with thermal power-station operations or routine water chemistry records is expected. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
